notes: Model identification on Hermes: ONE trivial no-tool `hermes chat` turn, after which the dashboard must name the model the session actually ran on and show that model's PUBLISHED context window. Hermes writes NO transcript file — the daemon reads one shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db (ProcessOwnedStore): metrics.model_name comes from the per-session `sessions.model` column (metrics.go querySessionMetrics, firstNonEmpty(model,'unknown')), and context_window comes from ComputeContextUtilization(model, TotalTokens, cm, 0) — with a ZERO override the capacity table is the ONLY window source, and the live boot model gpt-5.6-luna resolves there at context_window=1050000 (verified in ~/.local/share/irrlicht/model-capacity-cache.json). sessions.model is demonstrably per-session, not a config echo: the live store's cli/tui rows carry TWO distinct models (gpt-5.6-luna x18, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b x7). No -m flag is passed — `hermes chat -m MODEL` exists (v0.19.0 --help) but the daemon reads the same column either way and the only other model on this machine has no capacity entry, so this cell identifies the CONFIGURED BOOT model, as the codex/pi/opencode/mistral-vibe 5.2 siblings do. ARC: Hermes persists the inbound user row BEFORE the first LLM call and bumps sessions.message_count in the same write → non-terminal activity → working; the assistant row with finish_reason='stop' → turn_done → ready (parser.go finishReasonEndsTurn — an explicit boundary, no idle flush). BIRTH: the sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message, so the sub-second ready birth is carried by the transient proc-<PID> pre-session the scanner mints; session_birth is anchored to start UNPINNED and turn_end chains off turn_start (never off session_birth) so the presession cannot steal identity — the hermes 1-1/2-1/1-8/5-1 shape. NO metric hard-assertion is pinned, and for THIS cell that decision was traced rather than inherited: of verify's applyHardAssertions compares observations.model only against summary.model_name in the recording's *.replay.json.golden (validate/observations.go readGoldenSummary). summary.model_name IS set ungated in cmd/replay/metrics.go finalizeSummary (only the #766 total_tokens/context_window/context_utilization lift is antigravity-gated), hermes IS registered in cmd/replay/main.go's parser factory, and hermes' Parser sets ev.ModelName from the injected `_model` key which tailer propagates — so model is EXPORTER-CONDITIONAL for hermes, not architecturally blocked like tokens/cost (whose parser emits nothing). But hermes has no transcript file, its driver has no store→JSONL exporter, and there are ZERO hermes recordings today: with no golden a pin is vacuous (ValidateObservations → Skipped/Pass), and with a golden whose rows omit `_model` it HARD-FAILS while the daemon is correct. Same call as the opencode 5.2 sibling (observations null; its golden carries no model_name key). record must pin observations.model to the exact summary.model_name (gpt-5.6-luna here — NormalizeModelName leaves it unchanged) iff a golden appears carrying one, and must NOT add tokens_nonzero/cost_nonzero/context_window_nonzero, each of which would hard-fail a hermes golden. Until then both acceptance metrics are checked on the LIVE metrics surface at record time (see the cell recipe's verify[]).

text: A hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch (the transient proc-<PID> pre-session carries the sub-second birth; the store-backed <YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<hex> session lands once the first user message is persisted). Nothing ever enters waiting — one no-tool turn.
A PID is bound to the session (hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line, so the PID binds to the venv interpreter process)
The trivial user prompt drives the store-backed session ready → working (the user row is persisted before the LLM call, message_count grows, and the newest row is not an assistant/stop row)

The turn completes back to ready on the same session (assistant row with finish_reason='stop' → turn_done), closing the ready → working → ready topology with a final state of ready and zero tool calls. AFTER this point the live metrics surface must show model_name equal to the run's model.default and not 'unknown', plus context_window equal to that model's published window (1050000 for gpt-5.6-luna) with context_window_unknown false — asserted at the metrics tier, not in this phase DSL (events.jsonl carries no metric fields).
